body:
Ana C: Hey team — planning an AMA-style enablement for 6 priority accounts next week to cover onboarding checklists, renewal risks, and quick wins. Need help picking cadence + trainers. Who can cover a 45min slot?
Mike R: I can take one slot Tue/Wed afternoons. Prefer 3pm PT.
Tara L: I can do Wed 10am PT or Thu 11am PT. I’ll run the deep-dive on model routing & rollout tips.
Sam P: I’ll own the onboarding checklist section and the follow-up tasks. Prefer Thu afternoon.
Luis G: I’ll join for the renewal-risk Q&A. Availability Thu 11-2pm PT.
Ana C: Quick poll — options: Tue 3pm PT, Wed 10am PT, Thu 11am PT, Thu 4pm PT. Please react with :one: :two: :three: :four: or drop alternate times.
Mike R: :one: for me.
Tara L: :two: and :three: (leaning :three:).
Sam P: :three: works best.
Luis G: :three: nailed.
ops-bot: Calendar slot created tentatively for Thu 11am PT — awaiting final RSVP.
Ana C: Looks like Thu 11am PT wins. Agenda draft: 1) 10m quick intros & account context, 2) 15m onboarding checklist + common blockers, 3) 10m renewal-risk signals & mitigation, 4) 10m live Qs + next steps. Thoughts?
Tara L: Suggest swapping 2 & 3 — do renewal-risk signals before checklist so teams can prioritize fixes.
Mike R: Agree with Tara. Also can we cap attendees at 12 per account to keep it focused?
Ana C: Good call. Cap=12 and we'll record. Sam, can you prepare the one-pager checklist and a 3-slide post-call summary?
Sam P: Yep. I’ll drop checklist + slide deck in the shared folder by Wed EOD. Link will be in the calendar invite.
Ana C: Can someone draft the invite blurb? Short + action items.
Tara L: Draft: "Join our priority-account AMA — 45m to surface onboarding blockers, highlight renewal risks, and agree next action items. Bring 1-2 example prompts or infra questions. We'll record and send a 3-slide summary"
Mike R: Tiny tweak: add "Please RSVP with the customers' primary use case".
Ana C: Perfect. I’ll update invite and ping product-ops to enable recording. @ops-bot can you ensure meeting recording is enabled and Slack reminder 1hr before?
ops-bot: Recording enabled. Reminder set for 60 minutes prior.
Luis G: Final Q — do we want a post-session feedback form (2 Qs) for capture?
Sam P: Yes — 2 quick Qs: "Did this session unblock you?" (Y/N) and "Top remaining blocker" (free text). I’ll attach form link to post-call summary.
Ana C: Sweet. Thanks everyone — I’ll finalize invite and handoff trainer list. If anyone needs to swap, flag by Wed 9am PT. :thumbsup:
